title: Friendship is a verb

verse.sanskrit:
उपकारफलं मित्रमपकारोऽरिलक्षणम् ।
अद्यैव तं वधिष्यामि तव भार्यापहारिणम् ॥
verse.iast:
upakāraphalaṃ mitram apakāro 'rilakṣaṇam |
adyaiva taṃ vadhiṣyāmi tava bhāryāpahāriṇam ||
verse.translation: Help is the fruit of friendship; harm is the mark of an enemy. This very day I will slay the one who took your wife.

beats.title: your new friend drops a REAL problem
beats.vo: You just made a new friend, and right away he tells you: my own brother threw me out and took my wife.

beats.title: PLOT TWIST
beats.vo: Most people: wow, that's crazy, anyway. Rama? He just smiles at Sugriva, the exiled monkey king, and says: say less.
Because Rama knows this pain. Sita has been taken from him too. They've just sworn friendship with fire as their witness. Same hurt, new squad.
Help is the fruit of friendship. Harm is the mark of an enemy. This very day, I'll take down the one who took your wife.
For Rama, friendship isn't vibes. It's help. A friend is measured by what they actually do.
So skip, let me know if you need anything. Just show up with the thing.

beats.title: Day 13 of learning from Rama
beats.vo: Day thirteen of learning from Rama. Tag the friend who always shows up.

music_suggestions: An upbeat desi hip-hop or dhol track from Instagram's library
Any trending 'ride or die' or 'friendship goals' audio
caption:
Friendship is a verb 🤝

Sugriva, the exiled monkey king, told Rama his brother had thrown him out and taken his wife. Rama, who had just lost Sita himself, smiled and promised to help that same day.

“उपकारफलं मित्रमपकारोऽरिलक्षणम् । अद्यैव तं वधिष्यामि तव भार्यापहारिणम् ॥”
Valmiki Ramayana, Kishkindha Kanda 8.21

Help is the fruit of friendship. Don't just say 'let me know'. Show up. Day 13 of learning from Rama.
